look.summary_zh: 暖色 · 提亮中灰 · 中段跨度接近原值
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 138.1/255（变化 +10.6 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 0.980。中灰红减蓝 +7.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #F3DAC9、#D6A385、#896442；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #CC4E3B、#6AC178、#5B48BC。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 138.1/255 (+10.6 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 0.980; mid-gray red minus blue +7.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #F3DAC9, #D6A385, #896442. Red/green/blue swatches: #CC4E3B, #6AC178, #5B48BC.
look.suggested_use_zh: 暖色生活、餐饮与怀旧试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
